items.evidence: Log lines 2-193 show 18 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into each of the 96 pcr_plate wells with a single tip.
Log shows 1 uL colony_plate well -> matching pcr_plate well (lines 196-1153) and 1 uL primer_plate well -> matching well (1156-1537), all with the p20, giving 20 uL.
Each colony and each primer transfer is bracketed by its own pick up tip and drop tip in the log; the master-mix tip is reused only for empty wells, which is allowed.
The final protocol.comment records sealing and 98C 30 s; 30x[98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s]; 72C 2 min; hold 4C.
The steps follow the task order, including a 3x mix after the colony template, and the comments match the actions the code performs, with no invented steps.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the simulator log for all steps: 18 uL master mix into 96 wells, 1 uL colony template with 3x mix, and 1 uL primer mix, each on a fresh tip. The thermocycling comment is complete and the other comments and metadata are accurate.
